scope: Xuefu Avenue carriageways around Xueyuan footbridge, clipped to the existing terrain frame
basis: Both archived directional carriageways are preserved independently in the shared WGS84 frame; university-boundary clipping must not erase the public road beneath the footbridge.
limits: Widths remain highway-class estimates of 9 metres for each two-lane carriageway. No lane markings, traffic signals, roadside fixtures or planting positions are inferred. Existing sourced terrain supplies elevation; this is not surveyed bridge clearance. No other surrounding street is added by proximity. A 0.12m visual edging replaces the generic 1.5m apron so the separated carriageways retain their median; it is not a measured sidewalk or raised curb.
